hooks.name: player_recipe_book_settings_change
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerRecipeBookSettingsChange)

rust_summary: A server player's recipe book settings changed (`native_player_recipe_book_settings_change`).
doc_summary: A server player's recipe book open or filter setting changed: `native_player_recipe_book_settings_change(player, name, book, open, filtering)`, where `book` is its protocol id. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_recipe_book_settings_change@.
